question: For each of the deadly sins, if the bishop and witch were to meet, what sort of reaction do you think they would have to each other?
answer: For “Greed”, Regulus would get angry that Echidna talks so much. For “Gluttony”, Daphne would get angry about their different stances on food. For “Lust”, they hate each other’s personalities and try to kill each other. For “Sloth”, Petelgeuse hates all witches other than Satella, so he’d get minced by Sekhmet. For “Wrath”, once Minerva-tan realized that punching Sirius heals everyone nearby, she’d embark on a journey around the world, punching Sirius all the way and healing everyone.
